title: Install and retain a drive under a gravity-closing lid
instruction: Install the blue drive carrier in the chassis, insert the orange retaining bar, and leave the lid closed with both arms clear.
context: A proposed service workflow combining access support, guided carrier placement and mechanical closeout.
